entities.summary: Tuvalu is a sovereign nation in Polynesia, Oceania. Its capital is Funafuti. Official languages include Tuvaluan, English. Government: Unitary parliamentary constitutional monarchy. Population: approximately 0.0 million. Area: 26 km². Comprehensive index for Tuvalu covering Polynesian settlement (~3000 years ago), Ellice Islands naming (British, 1819), European contact (Alvaro de Mendaña 1568 Nui atoll), blackbirding/labour trade (1860s-70s, Peruvian slavers), Gilbert and Ellice Islands Colony (British, 1892-1975), separation from Kiribati 1975 (Ellice Islanders Polynesian voted to separate from Gilbertese Micronesian), independence 1978, .tv internet domain (major revenue), climate change existential crisis (lowest-lying nation candidate, maximum elevation 4.6m).
